quizName: DMV Practice Test #4 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When starting your motorcycle, the engine should be in:

options.text: First gear.
Neutral.
Third gear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Neutral.
questions.explanation: Always put your motorcycle in neutral before starting the engine. Most motorcycles have a neutral light on the speedometer that turns on when the ignition is on and the bike is in neutral.

questions.question: When riding, jackets and pants should:

options.text: Fit loosely enough to allow the wind to catch the fabric.
Be snug enough to keep from flapping in the wind.
Be tight enough to prevent you from moving freely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be snug enough to keep from flapping in the wind.
questions.explanation: Jackets and pants should fit snugly so they do not flap in the wind. They should be loose enough that you can move freely.

questions.question: When traveling at night, you should:

options.text: Ride as fast as you would if riding during the day.
Ride more slowly than you would if riding during the day.
Ride faster than you would if riding during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride more slowly than you would if riding during the day.
questions.explanation: Ride more slowly at night, especially on roads you do not know well. Slower speeds give you more time to spot and avoid hazards when visibility is low.

questions.question: Should you wear gloves while riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Yes. Your hands may get cold while riding.
Yes. They provide better grip and protect your hands.
No. Gloves can interfere with the controls.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes. They provide better grip and protect your hands.
questions.explanation: Gloves improve your grip and protect your hands. Use full-fingered gloves made of strong, durable material.

questions.question: Eye protection:

options.text: Is not necessary if your motorcycle has a windshield.
Is only necessary when riding in bad weather.
Should allow you to see clearly to both sides.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should allow you to see clearly to both sides.
questions.explanation: Eye or face protection is required by law in California. A face shield protects your whole face in a crash. Good eye or face protection must let you see clearly to both sides.

questions.question: When looking around your motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Look for escape routes near intersections, shopping areas, or schools.
See if you can travel faster than other vehicles.
Stare at pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for escape routes near intersections, shopping areas, or schools.
questions.explanation: While watching for hazards, look for escape routes at intersections, shopping areas, schools, and construction zones.

questions.question: To work properly, eye or face shield protection must:

options.text: Fasten securely.
Limit your side vision so you focus on the road ahead.
Not allow eyeglasses or sunglasses to be worn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fasten securely.
questions.explanation: Good eye or face protection must have no scratches, resist penetration, allow clear views to both sides, fasten securely, allow air to flow to prevent fogging, and fit eyeglasses or sunglasses if needed.

questions.question: When buying a motorcycle helmet, your main concern should be:

options.text: Price.
Protection.
Appearance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Protection.
questions.explanation: Protection should be your first priority when choosing a motorcycle helmet.

questions.question: Choose a lane position that:

options.text: Helps you avoid road hazards.
Hides you from other road users.
Places you directly next to another vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Helps you avoid road hazards.
questions.explanation: Pick a lane position that helps you avoid hazards. Keep a safe space around your motorcycle at all times.

questions.question: If you approach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time as another vehicle:

options.text: The vehicle on the left should yield to the vehicle on the right.
You should flash your headlight to signal the other vehicle to proceed.
You should continue through and expect the other vehicle to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left should yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no signs or traffic lights, if two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right.

questions.question: When the lights on this sign are flashing, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait until the train passes.
Proceed with caution.
Turn around and find an alternate route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait until the train passes.
questions.explanation: When you see flashing lights at a railroad crossing, you must stop completely. Wait until the train passes and the lights stop flashing before you drive. Never try to drive around a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Railroad crossing ahead
Yield
Reduce speed

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They tell drivers about dangers ahead. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: A benefit of keeping space between you and other vehicles is that:

options.text: You are better able to draft off of other vehicles.
You will be able to stop quickly.
You will have more time to react to what other drivers do.

questions.correctAnswerText: You will have more time to react to what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your motorcycle at all times. If something dangerous happens, you will have time to respond and room to move safely.

questions.question: When stopping your motorcycle with a passenger, you should:

options.text: Ride a little faster than you normally would.
Start slowing down earlier than you normally would.
Merge into smaller gaps in traffic than you normally would.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing down earlier than you normally would.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle. This extra weight makes your motorcycle slower to speed up, slow down, and turn. Start slowing down sooner and look for bigger gaps in traffic when carrying a passenger.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Always wear a jacket.
Only wear a jacket at night.
Only wear a jacket if it is cold.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always wear a jacket.
questions.explanation: Always wear a sturdy jacket with long sleeves when riding a motorcycle, no matter what the weather is.

questions.question: Taking a turn too fast can cause a rider to:

options.text: Accidentally end up in another lane of traffic.
Get through the turn faster.
Keep control of their motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Accidentally end up in another lane of traffic.
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast can cause you to drift into another lane or leave the road. Always slow down before you turn.

questions.question: Which of the following affects blood alcohol content (BAC)?

options.text: The amount of alcohol consumed
The drinker's height
The temperature outside

questions.correctAnswerText: The amount of alcohol consumed
questions.explanation: Three main things affect BAC: how much alcohol you drink, how fast you drink it, and your body weight.

questions.question: Which colors are best for motorcycle riders to wear?

options.text: Brown, gold, silver, and white
Blue, black, gray, and purple
Orange, red, yellow, and green

questions.correctAnswerText: Orange, red, yellow, and green
questions.explanation: Bright orange, red, yellow, and green are best for motorcyclists. These colors help other drivers see you on the road.

questions.question: When alcohol and drugs are used together, the effects:

options.text: Are less dangerous than when either is used alone.
Often balance out.
Can be stronger than when either is used alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be stronger than when either is used alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, can impair your riding. Some drugs become more dangerous when mixed with alcohol.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that allows you to turn in the direction you want to go.

questions.question: A rider's boots or shoes should:

options.text: Be below their ankles.
Cover their ankles.
Be made of soft, flexible material.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover their ankles.
questions.explanation: Choose sturdy boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: The best way to handle tailgaters is to:

options.text: Get off the roadway.
Change lanes and let them pass.
Ride faster.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Change lanes and let tailgaters pass. Speeding up creates more danger. The tailgater may just follow you at the higher speed.

questions.question: The best clothing for a motorcyclist:

options.text: Feels uncomfortable.
Provides protection in a crash.
Should not stand out to other motorists.

questions.correctAnswerText: Provides protection in a crash.
questions.explanation: Good riding clothing protects you in a crash, keeps you comfortable, and makes you visible to other drivers.

questions.question: The best way to help others see your motorcycle is to:

options.text: Use your headlight.
Maintain eye contact.
Wave at drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your headlight.
questions.explanation: Keep your headlight on at all times. Most motorcycles made after 1978 turn on the headlight automatically when running. Always check that your headlight works before you ride.

questions.question: To make it easier for other motorists to see you, you should:

options.text: Wear brightly-colored clothing while riding.
Wear darkly-colored clothing while riding.
Wave your arms while riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear brightly-colored clothing while riding.
questions.explanation: Wear brightly-colored clothing while riding. This helps other drivers see you, no matter what time of day it is.
